meta.name: search-term-miner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "mine my search terms", "find new keywords from converting queries", "build a negative-keyword list", or "cut wasted paid spend"; harvests converting queries into new keywords/ad-groups, builds a standing negative-keyword list and an n-gram waste report from the search-terms export, and delivers a maintenance diff (add / negate / move). Not for account structure — use campaign-architect; not for budget split — use budget-optimizer; not for computing the final RQS — use ad-account-auditor. 付费广告搜索词挖掘/否定关键词/浪费词清单

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从搜索词报表中挖掘新关键词并生成否定词清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理付费搜索广告并希望从搜索词中挖掘新关键词、减少浪费。
copy.tagline_en: Mine new keywords and build negative keyword lists from search term reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid search ads and want to mine new keywords and reduce wasted spend from search term data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析你提供的付费广告搜索词报告，将有转化的搜索词提炼为新关键词或广告组，同时从无转化但花费的搜索词中生成否定关键词列表和 n-gram 浪费报告，最后输出一份维护差异清单（添加/否定/移动）。
howto.when: 当你要求“挖掘搜索词”、“从转化查询中找新关键词”、“建立否定关键词列表”或“削减浪费的付费支出”时触发。

say.text: 帮我挖掘这份搜索词报告，找出可以添加的新关键词。
say.note: Claude 会分析报告，将有转化的查询提炼为新关键词。

say.text: 从这份搜索词导出中建立否定关键词列表和浪费报告。
哪些转化查询应该变成新关键词或广告组？这是搜索词和转化数据。
say.note: Claude 会筛选出高于阈值的转化查询，建议添加或移动。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze your paid ad search terms report, harvest converting queries into new keywords or ad groups, build a negative keyword list and an n-gram waste report from non-converting spend, and output a maintenance diff (add/negate/move).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "mine search terms", "find new keywords from converting queries", "build a negative-keyword list", or "cut wasted paid spend".

say_en.text: Mine this search terms report and find new keywords to add.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the report and harvest converting queries as new keywords.

say_en.text: Build a negative keyword list and waste report from this search terms export.
say_en.note: Claude will flag non-converting spend and generate negatives and waste report.

say_en.text: Which converting queries should become new keywords or ad groups? Here is the data.
say_en.note: Claude will filter converting queries above threshold and suggest add or move.
